title: Rosalind and the Parish
author: Tamsin Ishikawa
blurb: Freya Villalobos, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
